title: Contact Lists API v1 retired on 2026-04-30; endpoints return 404
summary: HubSpot sunset the v1 Contact Lists API on 2026-04-30 (moved from 2025-09-30). Since then the /contacts/v1/lists endpoints for creating, updating, deleting and reading lists and list contacts return HTTP 404. The replacement is the Lists API (2026-03 or v3), which uses a new listId instead of the v1 legacyListId.
migrationNote: Map each stored legacyListId to the new listId with GET /crm/lists/2026-03/idmapping?legacyListId=... (or POST /crm/lists/2026-03/idmapping for up to 10,000 ids; ids in missingLegacyListIds no longer exist), then move reads to GET /crm/lists/2026-03/{listId} and /crm/lists/2026-03/{listId}/memberships, and membership writes to PUT /crm/lists/2026-03/{listId}/memberships/add, /remove or /add-and-remove. The legacy GET /v1/lists/{legacyListId}/sizeAndEditsHistory/between endpoint was retired too and is not covered by this path pattern.

provenance.quote: On that date, Contact Lists API (v1) endpoints excluding the exceptions listed above will be deprecated and return 404 responses, and the Contacts API (v1) read endpoints listed above will stop returning list memberships.
The following endpoints will return a 404 error as of April 30, 2026.
